close_reason: Not needed. The serde construction pattern for #[non_exhaustive] types is intentional by design. kith-core's make_* helpers are correct.
description: jmap-chat-types marks Attachment, Reaction, MessageRevision, MessageAction, DeliveryReceipt, Endpoint, ChatMember, ChannelPermission as #[non_exhaustive] but provides no new() constructors. kith currently works around this with serde_json::from_value hacks (make_attachment, make_mention, etc. in kith-core). Add proper new() constructors to each type in jmap-chat-types, matching the pattern already used by Message::new(), Chat::new(), ChatContact::new(). Then bump jmap-chat-types version.
title: Add constructors to jmap-chat-types for #[non_exhaustive] types
